responder_available.description: Whether the responder committed to attending the incident.

eta_minutes.description: Minutes until the responder can arrive on site. Omit if not committed.

acknowledged_severity.description: Did the responder verbally acknowledge the severity level stated?

requires_backup.description: Did the responder request that a backup technician be arranged?

requires_parts.description: Did the responder indicate replacement parts are needed?

decline_reason.description: Reason for declining. Use 'none' if they accepted.

callback_requested_at.description: ISO-8601 time if the responder asked to be called back later.

verbatim_commitment.description: The responder's exact words committing to or declining the task.

next_action.description: What the agent should do next based on this call outcome.
